description: This is a JavaScript source file defining a UI component for the 'Home' page of a furniture shopping web application using LightningJS. It imports UI components, manages state, and defines the visual layout and behavior of the page including product listings, header, loading/error states, and modal interactions.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Returns initial reactive state variables for UI tokens, loading/error placeholders, product data, and modal visibility.

methods.name: watchers
methods.description: Defines reactive watchers for properties like width, height, products, and checkoutOpen to update UI layout and state accordingly.

methods.name: subscriptions
methods.description: Subscribes to the AppStore to synchronize component state with global store updates.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Initializes component by setting dimensions, loading products if not already loaded, and setting up initial state.
